test_from_pytorch_training_classificatio: test CrypTen training for classification models converted from PyTorch using BCELoss or CrossEntropyLoss
test_from_pytorch_training_regression: test CrypTen training for regression models converted from PyTorch using MSELoss
test_from_onnx: test construction of a CrypTen model from an ONNX graph exported from PyTorch
test_export_pytorch_model: test exporting a PyTorch model to ONNX format via an in-memory BytesIO buffer
test_get_operator_class: test that ONNX operator types map to valid CrypTen module classes and invalid types raise errors
